scope: Full-manuscript import and structural verification for all 75 essays, with selected complete readings, targeted cross-language factual/interpretive corrections, and UI testing. This is not a claim of exhaustive line-by-line linguistic review of all 75 texts or frame-by-frame verification of all five films.

preservation.received: Immutable byte-preserving Markdown copies with SHA-256 receipt
preservation.legacy: Existing simplified Chinese, traditional Chinese and English essay bodies unchanged; only language menus, alternates and hero edition labels updated
preservation.full_text: No summary substitution; all original numbered essay sections retained

targeted_corrections: Shawshank: the three hearings span twenty years, not thirty; retain the distinct thirty-year restroom voice-over.
Shawshank: distinguish unauthorized opera from Norton's revocable privileges; preserve Andy's remorse about his marriage; remove foreknowledge of the exact punishment.
Shawshank: replace a blanket claim that fear fades with a reading of bodily habit.
Forrest Gump: remove unsupported location/vehicle precision from Jenny's drug and balcony montage without changing the interpretation.
Titanic: present the unsupported Cal quotation as interpretation, not dialogue; the photograph does not establish that Rose piloted the plane.
Titanic: distinguish the one-in-twenty narrative proportion from probability; avoid an exact duration for the musicians' final playing.
Leon: retain age nineteen but remove an unestablished nineteen-year employment duration; do not assert that Tony knew nothing of the Italian past.
Leon: distinguish recognizing a child's wishes from endorsing weapons training; qualify universal psychological claims as readings of this character; distinguish value from profit to Tony.
